text.en:
Paragraph (f), subsection B of section one of Act Numbered Forty-one hundred and eighty,
known as the Public Works Act of nineteen hundred and thirty-five, is hereby amended so that item six, under
the caption Negros Occidental, should read as follows:
"6. For the construction of the Pontevedra-Antipolo-La Castellana road ............ P9,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, August 5, 1935.
